ICS 83.060PCD 13New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis Indian Standard prescribes classification based on particle size, requirements and methods of sampling and test for vulcanized crumb particulate, manufactured from rubber products like tyre and non-tyre. The rubber products include the vulcanized rejects, End-of-Life products.
